module: Pause menu provider for the "nearby activities" section. It reads the big map points of interest (freeroam_vueBigMap.getPoiData) and the level's raw POIs (gameplay_rawPois), computes the distance to the player (camera position, marker radius inferred), then keeps up to 6 items: 2 closest, 2 of medium distance and the rest at random, sorted by distance. Each item carries two buttons: view on the map and set a route.
notes: POIs of type spawnPoint and playerVehicle are excluded; a POI without a bigmap marker or without a position is ignored.
The "view" button opens the big map (freeroam_bigMapMode.enterBigMap, instant, routeTarget pause.bigmap) with autoSelectPoiId and a zoom of 0.75; it is disabled if context.isBigMapAllowed is false.
The "route" button calls freeroam_bigMapMode.navigateToMission(poiId); it is disabled during a career test drive (career_modules_testDrive.isActive()).
If no activity is found, getData returns a dummy item with id nearby.none.
The selection uses math.random: the content changes on every call.

executeNearbyActivityAction.desc: Executes the button (view/route) identified by buttonId. Returns false if buttonId is nil.

payload.desc: Data passed to the button's callback.

getData.desc: Builds the section data: {mode, sections = {{id = "nearbyActivities", title, items}}}. Each item contains id, title, icon, description (translated POI type), actionLabel, poiType, distanceM (m, rounded) and actions {view, route}.

returns.desc: Section data for the pause UI.
